summary: Reads a2 ASCII digits from a1 into a 96-bit fixed-point accumulator at a3 (multiply-by-10, add-digit per character via CRTAdd12 and F_96BitLeftShiftBy1), then normalizes: shifts out leading zero 16-bit words and bits while adjusting the exponent accumulator v11, stores the final exponent word at a3+10 and returns it. Called from sub_596245.

operations.description: Initialize the exponent accumulator v11 to 16462 (0x404E) and zero the 12-byte 96-bit accumulator at a3.
Parse digits only when the digit count a2 is non-zero.

For each digit: shift the 96-bit accumulator left by 2 (F_96BitLeftShiftBy1), add the saved previous value (CRTAdd12), shift left by 1 more, then add the digit byte from a1 (CRTAdd12); advance the string pointer.
Normalization: while the high DWORD of the 96-bit accumulator is zero, shift the value left by 16 bits and add 65520 (0xFFF0) to the exponent accumulator v11.
Normalization: while the mantissa's top bit (0x8000) is clear, shift the 96-bit value left by 1 (F_96BitLeftShiftBy1) and add 65535 (0xFFFF) to v11.
Store the final exponent word v11 at a3+10 and return it as the __int16 result.
